family.tagline: Farm calls all week, and the records come home with them.
family.story: Javier is a mobile large-animal veterinarian, and his truck is the clinic. Minseo teaches high-school art. With Ana and Theo, they keep the animal records and the home calendar on one Companion Core.

companion.name: Hank
companion.job: Opens Baserow in its own browser and logs each farm call and visit.
companion.limits: Logs what Javier reads out. He checks each row.

companion.name: Mina
companion.job: Drafts lesson notes and gallery-night flyers from what Minseo texts it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Minseo sends and prints them.

popup.title: A parcel while Javier is out
popup.body: The parcel waits in the entry while Javier is out on a call. Minseo carries it through the kitchen to the shelf in the living room.

popup.title: Theo opens the parcel
popup.body: Theo opens the parcel. Inside: the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. The Core covers about three quarters of a sheet of paper.

popup.title: The Core wakes up
popup.body: Javier sets the Core on the shelf and plugs it in. One press of the button, and it opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Ana takes the phone
popup.body: Ana joins the Core's own Wi-Fi from her phone. Javier reads out the home network's password, and she types it in.

popup.title: Agents and apps, picked together
popup.body: In Companion Hub, Javier picks OpenClaw and Minseo picks Hermes. They add Baserow, Baikal and Kiwix. Companion Memory (beta) comes too, with nothing connected yet. Then they walk away.

beats.capability: Hermes runs in its own sandbox on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Mina says hello
popup.body: Minseo sends the first message of the evening. Mina, the agent she named, answers.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: minseo
say.text: Hello, Minseo. I am Mina. What are we making?

beats.capability: Stream your own music collection to any device

popup.title: Ana builds the road-trip playlist
popup.body: Ana builds Saturday's drive playlist in Navidrome from the couch. The songs stream from the Core to the family's phones.

beats.capability: Store every password in a vault you host

popup.title: Passwords kept on the Core
popup.body: Minseo keeps the family's passwords in VaultWarden. The vault lives on the Core, on the shelf in the living room, and it works with the Bitwarden apps.

beats.capability: Manage and read books, comics and PDFs with automatic covers and metadata

popup.title: Art books by the fire
popup.body: Minseo browses her art books in BookLore beside the fireplace. Covers and details fill in automatically, and the library lives on the Core.

beats.capability: Build a no-code database for orders, inventory or projects

popup.title: Yesterday's calls, logged
popup.body: The notes used to ride in the glovebox. Javier reads out yesterday's calls, and Hank logs each one in Baserow, in its own browser. Javier checks every row.

say.speaker: javier
say.text: Rows added. Please check each one.

beats.capability: A small CalDAV and CardDAV server for your calendars and contacts

popup.title: Farm calls and classes, one calendar
popup.body: Javier's farm calls and Minseo's classes share one calendar through Baikal. It lives on the Core and syncs to both phones.

beats.capability: A family planner with a shared calendar, tasks, shopping, meals, notes, contacts and budget in one

popup.title: Sunday supper, planned
popup.body: Minseo plans Sunday supper for four in Yuvomi's meal planner. Ana adds the dessert, and the shopping list updates on every phone.

beats.capability: Build a no-code database for orders, inventory or projects

popup.title: Supply shelves, counted
popup.body: Javier counts the supply shelves into a second Baserow table, so the reorder list sits beside the call log. Both live on the Core.

beats.capability: Keep a service history, fuel log and reminders for every vehicle

popup.title: The truck gets a logbook
popup.body: The truck is the clinic, so it keeps a logbook. Javier records each service and fill-up in LubeLogger, which reminds him before the next one.

beats.capability: A local video recorder with object detection for your IP cameras

popup.title: The supply room, recorded at home
popup.body: An IP camera over the supply shelves streams to Frigate. The recordings stay on the Core, and Javier reviews clips on the home network.

beats.capability: Hermes runs in its own sandbox on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Mina drafts the gallery flyer
popup.body: Gallery night is Friday. Minseo texts Mina the details, and Mina drafts the flyer text. Minseo lays it out in Inkscape and prints it herself.

say.speaker: minseo
say.text: Flyer text drafted. Please read it before you print.

beats.capability: A shared whiteboard on an infinite canvas

popup.title: A lesson, drawn together
popup.body: Minseo sketches next week's lesson on a tldraw whiteboard. Ana adds a few lines of her own, and the board stays on the Core.

popup.title: Signed estimates, filed once
popup.body: After a long day, Javier scans the signed estimates at the table. Paperless-ngx reads every page, tags it and files it.

beats.capability: Read ebooks in your browser, with notes, highlights and text-to-speech

popup.title: Bedtime, one chapter further
popup.body: Theo reads the next chapter of his adventure book in Koodo Reader at bedtime, and highlights his favorite line.

beats.capability: Read Wikipedia and other reference sites offline

popup.title: A school project on owls
popup.body: Ana researches desert owls for a school project. Kiwix keeps Wikipedia on the Core, so she reads it from her room.

beats.capability: Turn habits and chores into a game with levels and quests

popup.title: Tidying the toy box, for points
popup.body: Theo tidies the toy box and ticks it off in Habitica. Chores become quests, with levels, and the game runs on the Core.

beats.capability: Save places on a map and plan multi-day trips with a budget

popup.title: The summer trip, mapped
popup.body: Under the terrace shade, Minseo saves places on a map in TRIP and plans the summer trip day by day.

beats.capability: Back up, search and organise your family photos and videos on your own Core

popup.title: Photos backed up by the fire
popup.body: Around the firepit, Javier backs up the day's photos to Immich. Ana picks the ones that go in the family album.

popup.title: Records at home, not the truck
popup.body: Farm calls all day, and the records come home. The Delgado-Park family keeps them on one Companion Core, not in the glovebox.

closing.body: Your records, your calendar and your stock counts can live on a Companion Core at home instead of the glovebox.

notes: FTUE follows the owner-specified hotspot flow; the fact sheet says only "plug it in, pair it over Wi-Fi, and walk away". Owner sign-off open.
No living-room TV and no kitchen island in this house: the media beats are at the couch and the fireplace; the kitchen beats say the counter. The Core stands on a shelf, so there is no desk beat.
Animals only: no beat makes a claim about anyone's health. garage-camera assumes an IP camera owned by the family (not in the parcel, not in the 3D scene).
The render does not show a desert; the setting is never described beyond the house and the pool terrace. Apps picked to leave the busiest store apps to other families.
Motif: the glovebox. Beats kitchen-calls, garage-truck, outro-street, closing.
